items.content:
Now that the post-launch waters have settled, Kraken Express is steering the ship towards its first big Windrose update. The pirate survival game exploded onto the scene in April in fittingly dramatic fashion - racking up more than two million sales and even briefly outstripping the pace of the mighty Rust on Steam. That's a lot of adventurers ready for their next outing across the water, and the studio promises that our journey to the Windrose Ashlands will see "the main story and side quests grow significantly in scope."

items.name: Windrose Devblog: Ashlands (WIP)
items.title: Windrose Devblog: Ashlands (WIP)
items.author: Bambino
items.summary: DISCLAIMER: We’re talking about plans, and plans may change. We tend to experiment a lot. If something does not work well for the game, we discard it. Prototyping a great idea can drastically change how it feels once we actually playtest it. Simply put, if something isn’t great, we tend to pivot it into something a lot better. That’s the nature of development, and it applies to the plans described below. In the end, these are general thoughts we’ll continue expanding on as development...
items.content:
DISCLAIMER: We’re talking about plans, and plans may change. We tend to experiment a lot. If something does not work well for the game, we discard it. Prototyping a great idea can drastically change how it feels once we actually playtest it. Simply put, if something isn’t great, we tend to pivot it into something a lot better. That’s the nature of development, and it applies to the plans described below. In the end, these are general thoughts we’ll continue expanding on as development progresses.Ahoy, captains! It’s been a while since the Early Access release, thank you for making it incredible!Now that most of the post-release tasks have been addressed, we’re hard at work on Windrose’s first major content update, currently titled “Ashlands.” While development is still in its early stages, we wanted to share our general plans and give you an idea of what we’re aiming for. As always, the exact scope of the update may change as development progresses.

Watch on YouTube →

As for our longer-term plans, those are still taking shape. Truth be told, we don’t have them fully locked in yet. While delivering Early Access, we spared no effort to make and patch the game as well as we could, and it took a real toll on us. As a result, this part had to be pushed aside for a while. Now that the game is live, feedback has poured in, and we are better equipped with your ideas and a clearer understanding of what Windrose could become in the future.In that sense, Windrose is shaped not only by our own ideas, but also by your feedback and experiences. Our goal is to first deliver Ashlands at the level of quality we expect from ourselves, learn from your impressions, and then build on that foundation with a clearer understanding of what comes next.Now, let’s discuss Ashlands.

The story continues

We have always wanted Windrose to be a survival adventure with a strong narrative layer, making the journey through its vast biomes feel meaningful.In Ashlands, you can expect both the main story and side quests to grow significantly in scope.This is where new factions enter the fray, and you’ll have to carve your way through their ambitions and schemes to continue your journey. Your hunt for the Obols continues, with the next fragment hidden somewhere among the ruins of a long-forgotten Spanish colony. The Obol’s power has twisted lands already ravaged by volcanic eruptions, making them more dangerous than ever. And let’s just say you’re not the only one searching for the artifact.As we stated before, we’re working hard to make sure you’ll be able to continue your adventure and keep all the progress you’ve already achieved.[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/528dc2b879d999bfc85f77423f86d5d959f01579.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/ef3ed3ca625ff54c3f0efabc13c5d6fabb9b1d3e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/e7fcc329f4086e5fcd75a487f796c2320889a25d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/97029101cbcc2787a0e0610dd37c1db4949bbe7f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/c7b1db6391c50ba07b32f56128580e8703ebbc15.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/46493dda0e18f7d2f26ef41b9dc15d02f82f7234.png"]Buccaneers, refreshed — WIP
Updated costume concepts for the Buccaneer faction. Other factions are getting attention as well.[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/31eeab2e03e6a5386c7b7fb44c82287ef681f1d1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/9107c5bdbfca59c711ff6c67ce4fd43f6e82fff4.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/51cf1d2cf07fd94d8a2b0205075cb2a9a61f5cb5.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/b7f12786bbb7912a299209649a83af880c1eaf66.png"]New armor on the horizon — WIP
A first look at concept work for possible character armor sets. 

New biome: Ashlands

We are going to introduce a complete fourth biome: Ashlands. As the name suggests, it suffered from volcanic eruptions long ago, leaving its mark on the settlers who lived here, and on those who came after.Uncover relics and secrets of the past, preserved under volcanic ash, but be prepared for those who may still guard these treasures. You can expect a variety of new islands with new enemies, items, resources, recipes, points of interest, and, of course, a new challenging boss. Brand-new factions will enter the stage, too, and you’ll be able to expand your collection with new armor and weapon variants.We want every biome to feel and play differently, so on top of all the new content, we’re also looking into new biome mechanics to experiment with.

Building and bases

We were stunned by the number of amazingly creative builds you showcased, and we’ll happily expand this aspect of the game in Ashlands. We plan to introduce a plethora of new decorations, expand the existing building sets with useful new pieces, and work on a couple of QoL improvements.Speaking of which, don’t forget to visit our community ideas page to vote for various requests and submit your own: https://windrose.support/ideasWe’re also happy to see that our camp NPCs were well received, so we’ll be looking to expand this system as well.

Ships

We feel that our ship gameplay has a lot of room for expansion, and we also have tons of your ideas and requests to draw from. It won’t be possible to tuck everything we’d like into one update, but we’ll surely experiment with and implement a few additions to this part of Windrose.
Here are a few things we’re looking into:
  • Enriching and deepening ship gameplay in ways inspired by both your feedback and our own plans[/*]
  • More ship classes, with at least one being added in Ashlands, plus more faction ship variants[/*]
  • Giving combat gameplay more care and attention[/*]
  • AI improvements, such as NPC ships behaving more naturally, sailing in formations, and so on[/*]
We are also aware of the popular request to add wind influence on sailing to the game. We’ll definitely be exploring this idea as well, and we originally intended to. But let us be crystal clear: we want it to be fun and simple. Windrose aims to be an adventure, without some of the more hardcore simulation aspects.And, of course, expect more shanties! We were deeply touched by how well these were received. We don’t want to spoil everything, but your collection will be significantly expanded.[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/d539c1ccaa92b45777e0b011174f9dd16235e04f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/2cc43faefdcdc3c8d64678bba46923cafeb65e6e.png"]More ships for the seas — WIP
We're currently working on the Brigantine, Fluyt, and Galleon. While plans may change, we expect at least one of these ships to make its way into Ashlands.

Conclusion

That’s the general direction we’re taking with Ashlands. If you have any questions about the update, let us know in the comments. We’ll do our best to answer them in a future Q&A edition.As always, we’ll be sharing more details, including an estimated release window, as development progresses. Thank you for your incredible support, and we’ll see you soon on the seas!Kraken Express

items.title: Patch Notes: Version 0.10.0.6
items.author: Bambino
items.summary: Hey, captains! We’re releasing another small update that fixes several issues. We’re closely monitoring your reports and will continue rolling out hotfixes and improvements.Patch NotesVersion: 0.10.0.6[*]Reduced disk space usage and optimized disk writes during gameplay.[/*][*]Slightly improved performance during boarding.[/*][*]Slightly improved performance when using ship artillery.[/*][*]Player and ship action panels now execute actions when a button is pressed instead of when it is...
items.content:
Hey, captains! We’re releasing another small update that fixes several issues. We’re closely monitoring your reports and will continue rolling out hotfixes and improvements.[p align="justify"]

Patch Notes

[p align="justify"]Version: 0.10.0.6
  • [p align="justify"]Reduced disk space usage and optimized disk writes during gameplay.[/*]
  • Slightly improved performance during boarding.[/*]
  • Slightly improved performance when using ship artillery.[/*]
  • Player and ship action panels now execute actions when a button is pressed instead of when it is released.[/*]
  • Slightly adjusted attack and block animation transitions after equipping weapons for smoother and more responsive gameplay.[/*]
  • Added SaveWorkflow.md to the Dedicated Server root folder.[/*]
  • All plants placed by the player should now correctly snap to soil patches.[/*]
  • Items dropped on player-built soil patches will no longer fall through the ground.[/*]
  • Slightly updated onion flower visuals.[/*]
  • If two players are fighting different bosses simultaneously, killing one boss will no longer grant the achievement to the other player.[/*]
  • Disabled running multiple server instances on the same PC.[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a known issue from the previous update where old worlds and characters could not be deleted correctly.[/*]
  • Fixed a rare bug where killing monsters in Stargazer Ruins could incorrectly count as a Jim Godart kill.[/*]
  • Fixed a bug that could occasionally cause ship artillery aiming to get stuck.[/*]
  • Fixed a bug where ship aiming could get stuck when interacting with a battery while blocking.[/*]
  • Fixed a bug that caused the "Unstuck" command to become unavailable while controlling a ship battery.[/*]
  • Fixed a crash that could occasionally occur when unequipping items from a ship.[/*]
  • Fixed an issue that prevented Dedicated Server users from changing settings in WorldDescription.json. For instructions, see DedicatedServer.md in the Dedicated Server root folder.[/*]

items.content:
Hey, captains!Another incredible milestone in our journey — 2,000,000 brave souls have plunged into the Archipelago to live the swashbuckling life alongside us![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/2c3ce4dce9a3e238446f7cd083c1ffef18815744.png"]When we first set sail, we could only hope that our game would find such a passionate and dedicated community. Seeing so many of you exploring the seas, sharing your stories, creating content, reporting issues, and supporting us every step of the way means more than we can properly express.Every screenshot, every stream, every review, every bug report, and every kind word has helped shape this adventure into something truly special. The Archipelago feels alive because of you.In terms of development updates, we’re planning to release another patch soon to address several common issues reported by the community. After that, we begin full production on the next major update. We’re still discussing the scope of that update internally, so it will take some time before we can share more details. However, our goal remains the same: to continue expanding the experience in meaningful ways and make the wait worthwhile.Thank you again, captains. This milestone is a new beginning for us, for the game, and for the community we’re building together. We are deeply touched by your support and will continue working hard to make this adventure worthy of your time and passion.Fair winds and following seas,
Kraken Express

items.name: Patch Notes, version: 0.10.0.5.120-073042fb
items.title: Patch Notes v0.10.0.5.120 — Steam Cloud Saves Fix & Stability Update
items.author: Bambino
items.summary: Kraken Express rolls out Patch v0.10.0.5.120 targeting Steam Cloud Save corruption and overall game stability improvements.
items.content:
Developer Kraken Express has released Patch v0.10.0.5.120 for Windrose, primarily addressing a critical issue with Steam Cloud Saves that was causing save corruption for some players.

What Changed

  • Steam Cloud Saves Fix — Resolved an issue where cloud saves could become corrupted during sync, potentially causing progress loss
  • Stability Improvements — General crash fixes and performance optimizations
  • Save System Hardening — Additional safeguards added to prevent future save-related issues

Guide Impact Analysis

This patch primarily affects the technical side of the game rather than gameplay mechanics. However, players who lost progress due to save corruption may need to revisit early-game content.

  • Server Guide: Dedicated server operators should update to this version. Check our Dedicated Server Guide for update instructions.
  • FAQ: We've updated our FAQ page with information about recovering from save corruption.
  • No recipe or balance changes — All crafting, resource, and boss data remains current.

Developer Note

Kraken Express stated they will be "closely monitoring feedback" after this update, suggesting further stability patches may follow quickly.
items.guide_impact: Update /server-guide with new version info. Update /faq with save corruption recovery steps.

items.title: Patch Notes, version: 0.10.0.5.120-073042fb
items.author: Bambino
items.summary: Hey, captains! We’re rolling out a new Steam Cloud Saves update intended to fix the issue with corrupted saves. We’ll be closely monitoring your feedback and will respond accordingly if any issues arise.Version: 0.10.0.5.120-073042fbSave files improvementsImplemented a new storage and backup system for save files[/*]The game now automatically backs up all data every 10 minutes of gameplay and upon exiting[/*]Updated the save file structure for cloud synchronization to minimize syncing...
items.content:
Hey, captains! We’re rolling out a new Steam Cloud Saves update intended to fix the issue with corrupted saves. We’ll be closely monitoring your feedback and will respond accordingly if any issues arise.Version: 0.10.0.5.120-073042fb

Save files improvements

  • Implemented a new storage and backup system for save files[/*]
  • The game now automatically backs up all data every 10 minutes of gameplay and upon exiting[/*]
  • Updated the save file structure for cloud synchronization to minimize syncing issues[/*]
  • Broken save files no longer block the game from loading[/*]
  • Data Recovery UI: If the latest save file for a world or character is found to be broken at startup, a special UI window will appear. Players can either quit the game (e.g., to attempt a cloud resync) or recover data from a backup. The game will automatically offer the latest available one[/*]
  • Save Migration System: Implemented a system to migrate old save files (pre-version 0.10.0.5.120-073042fb) to the new format. In most cases, this process is seamless and invisible[/*]
  • Migration Conflict Handling: If the game detects old, corrupted save files that cannot be properly migrated, a notification window will appear with information about the affected files and a prompt to delete them
    [/*]

Other updates

  • Fixed an issue where D-pad Left was incorrectly mapped to the "Take All" action in the crafting station UI[/*]
  • Updated the Wolf Head item icon[/*]

Known Issue

  • Characters created before version 0.10.0.4 cannot be deleted due to Steam Cloud synchronization. This is a known issue and will be fixed in a future update.[/*]
  • Your game settings will be reset after this patch. Please back them up manually if needed.[/*]

items.name: New Windrose update fixes your holey roofs with more building pieces, and its performance foundations are now much sturdier
items.title: Ashlands Preview & Building Update — New Pieces, Better Performance
items.author: PCGamesN
items.summary: Kraken Express previews the upcoming Ashlands biome and delivers a building system update with new pieces and major performance improvements.
items.content:
Windrose has been out in open waters for just over two weeks, and developer Kraken Express has already charted a course towards its next major update. The upcoming Ashlands biome is the headline feature on the horizon, but in the meantime, players are getting immediate improvements to the building system and performance.

New Building Pieces

The update adds several new building components that address community feedback about roof construction gaps and limited architectural options:

  • New roof corner pieces that eliminate the notorious "holey roof" problem
  • Additional wall variants for more creative base designs
  • Improved snapping system for smoother building placement

Performance Improvements

The performance update focuses on the foundation systems that affect all aspects of gameplay:

  • Reduced frame drops in areas with many structures
  • Improved network synchronization for co-op building
  • Better memory management for extended play sessions

Ashlands Biome Preview

While the Ashlands biome is still at least 6 months away, Kraken Express has teased new environmental hazards, unique resources, and boss encounters that will come with the expansion. Players should focus on mastering current content and preparing strong gear sets.

Guide Impact Analysis

  • Building Guide: Our Building Guide needs updating with the new roof and wall pieces.
  • Beginner Guide: The improved building system makes base construction more accessible for new players.
  • Resource Planning: No new crafting materials added — existing resource guides remain accurate.
items.guide_impact: Update /building with new building pieces. Note Ashlands timeline in relevant pages.

items.name: New accolades trailer to celebrate over 1,500,000 copies sold!
items.title: Windrose Celebrates 1.5 Million Copies Sold — Accolades Trailer Released
items.author: Bambino
items.summary: Kraken Express celebrates 1.5 million copies sold in just two weeks with a new accolades trailer, thanking the community and hinting at future content.
items.content:
Ahoy, captains! Windrose has officially surpassed 1,500,000 copies sold in just two weeks since its Early Access launch on April 14, 2026. Developer Kraken Express marked the occasion with a special accolades / thank-you trailer celebrating the milestone.

By the Numbers

  • 1.5 million+ copies sold in 16 days
  • 150,000+ peak concurrent players
  • Steam Wishlist count exceeded 1.5 million before launch
  • Demo was downloaded over 850,000 times

What the Developers Said

In their announcement, Kraken Express expressed gratitude to the community: "That's a token of our appreciation to each and every one of you who believed in Windrose and set sail with us." They also hinted at exciting plans for the future of Windrose during its Early Access journey.

What This Means for the Game

Strong early sales give Kraken Express the resources to deliver on their roadmap, which includes:

  • The Ashlands biome — a major content expansion expected in 6+ months
  • Expansion from 4-player co-op to 8-player co-op
  • Approximately 50% more content planned for the full release
  • Continued bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements

Guide Impact

No direct gameplay changes, but the milestone confirms the game's longevity and validates investing time in comprehensive guides. Expect the player base to continue growing as positive word-of-mouth spreads.

items.author: Bambino

In this update, we’ve focused on addressing some of the most commonly reported issues so far.[p align="justify"]Among the changes, you’ll notice improved connection stability, reduced disk and CPU usage, and a variety of quality-of-life adjustments designed to make your overall experience smoother.[p align="justify"]As for Steam Cloud Save fixes, they’re still on the way. items.content:
Ahoy, captains![p align="justify"]Thank you for your patience and support throughout our journey. In this update, we’ve focused on addressing some of the most commonly reported issues so far.[p align="justify"]Among the changes, you’ll notice improved connection stability, reduced disk and CPU usage, and a variety of quality-of-life adjustments designed to make your overall experience smoother.[p align="justify"]As for Steam Cloud Save fixes, they’re still on the way. After additional internal testing, we decided to give them more time to ensure everything works reliably before release.

Patch notes

Version: 0.10.0.4.268-9d2ca277

Important bits

  • [p align="justify"]Added a new setting: Force Relay Connection. Doesn't work with Direct IP connections. Sometimes players are unable to connect directly to their friends’ games because P2P traffic is blocked along the route. This can happen for many reasons, such as router settings, ISP restrictions, firewall restrictions, and more. This option forces the use of our relay servers instead of a direct P2P connection, which can improve stability at the cost of higher latency (ping)[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a bug that caused connection issues for players with non-English Windows usernames[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed unnecessary CPU usage on idle servers and clients[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Disk usage during gameplay has been reduced[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Several improvements to ship performance when hosting a server[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a rare crash caused by invalid inventory slot IDs[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a crash that occurred when killing Drowned with ship cannon fire[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Reduced the crafting cost of a wide range of building pieces across all building sets (this applies to construction costs, not vendor prices)
    [/*]

New stuff

  • [p align="justify"]Added around 40 missing wall triangle pieces for various roof angles[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Added 3 missing floor triangle pieces to different building sets[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Added 4 new Seedbed variations[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Added new sound effects for when crops transition between growth stages[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Added new sounds for harvesting grown plants at your farm[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Added audio cues for Drowned ranged attacks; they now yell before hurling a projectile[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Added new visual effects for when crops transition between growth stages[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Added new visual effects for harvesting grown plants at your farm[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Bonfire ambient music track has been extended by 3 minutes[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Ship travel ambient track has been extended by 40 seconds
    [/*]

Interface

  • [p align="justify"]Fixed FrameGen stuttering that occurred when closing the inventory or map[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a video memory (VRAM) spike when opening certain UI windows[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]The Disassembly station no longer displays equipped items in the list[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fast travel markers will now appear on the top layer of the map when fast travel is available[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed remapping issues for the O and L keys[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Arrow key inputs no longer rotate the character camera[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Mouse inversion now correctly affects ship and ship battery controls[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Sensitivity settings now correctly affect aiming with ranged weapons[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]The "\" tag will no longer appear in the journal if the shared progress setting is disabled[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Added remapping support for more actions: secondary interactions, inventory management, HUD toggle, etc[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Two-handed firearm controls can now be remapped as well[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]The "Hide UI" toggle now only hides the HUD and no longer affects the inventory, journal, or other menus[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Added a dedicated setting to adjust safe zones for widescreen monitors[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a bug where settings could change value even if not directly hovered over by the gamepad cursor[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a mapping issue for accented letters[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Improved support for accented letters in player and ship names. We are working on expanding our custom font to natively support more languages soon
    [/*]

Building & Terraforming fixes and improvements

  • [p align="justify"]Decorative Canopies now count as roofs for crafting station requirements[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed cases where digging under a tree could cause it to "hang in the air"[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a bug that allowed players to dig under Divi stumps or certain trees in swamps[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed the shovel flatten tool, it now correctly uses the ground under the character's feet as a baseline[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Building integrity now correctly recalculates if a destructible object used as a support is destroyed[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a bug that caused Crocodile sculptures (Jolly Crocodile Sculpture, Wise Crocodile Sculpture)  to levitate slightly[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed clipping issues with 26-degree Mahogany stairs[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed snapping issues for 26-degree roof corners in the Jungle Survivor set[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed collision issues for 26-degree and 45-degree railings, they can now be correctly placed on foundations and floors[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed square pillar collisions (existing player-built structures should not be affected)[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed the visual offset for pier pillars (existing player-built structures should not be affected)[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Signal Fire now has the correct collision preset (you can now walk over it)[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Saplings can now be planted with higher density (reduced spacing requirements)[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Signal Fire now shares the Comfort buff with other fire-related entities. Pier decorations now correctly provide their own Comfort bonus[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a bug that occasionally made certain building blocks indestructible
    [/*]

Other bug fixes and improvements

  • [p align="justify"]Improved the drop rate for Tainted Bile[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Hardwood drop rate increased by approximately 20%[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Ship disassembly now requires the player to have enough inventory space (or a nearby chest) to store all returned resources, preventing item loss[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed the Boar's second strike combo animation: it now has a clearer telegraph but a longer reach. Be careful![/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed the Alpha Wolf's bleed effect, it now correctly applies only at the end of the grapple[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Bleed damage will no longer affect players while they are being grappled[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a visual bug with the Outnumbered effect while it is active[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a bug where the "Special Attack" damage bonus on jewelry did not work, it now correctly applies to all \ attacks[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed Rosalinda Mercer's perk: the 30% chance to proc on a purple elixir now correctly grants a purple elixir instead of a blue one[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a bug that could cause a teleport when jumping over a growing tree[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed several ore respawn bugs, ores should now always respawn correctly[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Cycling through shanties will now always result in a different song[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed several audio issues that occurred while using the F-camera on a ship[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Ship crew barks (voice lines) can now be heard even when using the F-camera[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Weapons are now correctly unequipped if the player removes a backpack containing them[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed several ship interaction animations that caused sailors to clip into objects[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed clothing clipping bugs when interacting with shrouds on a ship[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]The quest to board the "Unsinkable" can now be completed even if the player stays on their own ship's deck during boarding[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed an issue that caused Jim Godart to spawn extra copies of himself[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a rare error in sea quest battles that occurred if a player left the game mid-fight[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed a bug in the "Forgotten Relics" quest caused by receiving all three mural messages from a single ruin (excess markers will now disappear)[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed an incorrect tooltip for the Iron Caverns in Foothills; it will no longer display XP
    [/*]

Visual improvements

  • [p align="justify"]Fixed distorted visuals for several weapons on low graphics settings[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Grass will no longer be removed when planting trees or shrubs[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Grass will no longer be removed under piers and wharves[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Updated the Wolf Head Trophy model and textures[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed fireplace visuals[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed clay wall textures[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Slightly updated smelter visuals[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Fixed bean sapling visuals, vines should now correctly attach to the wooden supports[/*]
  • [p align="justify"]Improved the visibility of decorative beams for the Old World and Lost Tribe sets[/*]

items.content:
Ahoy, captains! We’re into the third week since release, and the high seas remain busy: while Windrose gathered a little less concurrent players over the last weekend compared to the first one, it’s still sailing steady (over 210,000 captains swashbucklin’ at the same time on Sunday!), and the number of daily players actually keeps growing! We’re thrilled to see such passion for our game, and thank you wholeheartedly for this. In fact, we’re preparing a little surprise for you to celebrate, but for now, let’s focus on some serious, yet important things you need to know.

Windrose.support: new platform for support, bug reports and feature suggestions

We are introducing a new tool for the community – https://windrose.support/Consider it a beta for now, but as we streamline it a bit, it will fulfill several duties:
  • You can troubleshoot any issues you have with the game there. It contains a growing and systematically organized database of the most common issues and solutions, and will help you to navigate to the information you need. If your problem turns out to be new, you will be able to contact our team directly as well.[/*]
  • You can easily report the bugs you have found. The form on this website will allow you to do it quickly and place your report into the right category.[/*]
  • You can provide your ideas for Windrose there, and vote for other players’ ideas! This is the new, transparent way for the community to share their ideas and expectations, and upvote the most popular ones so we can review and consider them.[/*]
As this tool is rather complex and new, please expect some bugs here and there, and for now it is localized in English only, however, as we put it to real use, it will be improved. Please note: we are going to gradually sunset the overlapping functions in our Discord, as this new platform makes the process much easier for players and devs alike.

Next update: a pack of fixes incoming

Right now we are internally testing the next game update focused on various important fixes and improvements. We will probably ask some of you to try it in advance as well before we roll it out for everyone. For now it is not 100% clear if we will manage to do it this week – but we will do our best! Here are some of the things that we’re planning to address with it:
  • Connectivity issues;[/*]
  • CPU usage on idle clients and servers;[/*]
  • Disk usage during gameplay (to reduce the load on SSD specifically);[/*]
  • Performance and stability improvements;[/*]
  • Over 40 new building pieces to fill some gaps and inconsistencies;[/*]
  • Over 50 fixes and QoL changes;[/*]
There is also a chance we will be able to address Steam Cloud Saves problems there, complementing the current saves backup system with a more robust solution. If we will, though, your game settings will be set to default after the update, so if these settings are important, please write them down or make a screenshot so you can dial them back later!

The most popular question: next big update

Some of you have already completed the game's current story, and some of you are simply (rightfully!) curious about where and how Windrose is heading. Well, here is the current status:
  • After we’re done with the fixes described above, we plan to fully switch to the next big content update, which will introduce the next biome called Ashlands;[/*]
  • The roadmap of this update is very high level now, we’re populating it with our own plans and some popular requests, and then, as it’s always with the game development, we will sit down and cut out some of the stuff to make it actually deliverable. Somewhere at this point we will be ready to present it to you, captains, so expect more information to come in a month or two.[/*]
  • Our philosophy now is to enrich the current gameplay systems, instead of only adding new biomes with the respective content, so even before we have the full details, it’s safe to say the game will not just grow in size – it will also evolve.[/*]
  • The scope of what we want to do is rather ambitious, so our best bet right now this update will take at least 6 months to deliver. This might sound like a long time, but we believe it will allow us to roll out an exciting and meaningful expansion to the game of appropriate quality. In other words, we will work very hard so it’s worth the wait.[/*]
This is it for today, captains, thank you, and stay tuned!Kraken Express

1,000,000 copies sold in 6 days, and over 200,000 players online!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546879/9e28500962fb725136f65d421ea531e999d5cff9.png"]Ahoy, captains! We have just plundered another milestone – 1,000,000 copies, and “we” means “you” – a crew of fine brave captains sailing the seas of Windrose. While we keep working on the game, we read your reviews and comments, watch your videos and streams, and sometimes, honestly, shed a pirate-y tear of happiness, because now when the game is out you share our dream of swashbuckling adventure. And there are boars, too, we know, but whatever does not send you flying into the nearest tree, makes you stronger, right?Thank you for this, captains. items.summary: Windrose is sailing with the wind at its back, and the new pirate survival game has proved such a hit that it's even managed to dethrone the longstanding champion of the genre. With the publishing might of Pocketpair behind it (the studio responsible for breakout success Palworld), developer Kraken Express has built a gorgeous PvE experience that's proving extremely popular, growing steadily over its first week. items.content:
Dear captains,Over the past few days, some of you have encountered several issues. Our team has been working in emergency mode to resolve them as quickly as possible so that more players can enjoy the game without disruptions.
Version: 0.10.0.3.104-256f9653

CONNECTIVITY SERVER SELECTION

We identified issues with certain ISPs blocking parts of our networking services. To address this, we’ve implemented the following changes:
  • Connectivity Server Selection: You can now manually choose a specific connectivity server instead of relying on automatic selection. You can also see which servers are reachable. Dedicated server settings can be configured via ServerDescription.json.[/*]
  • Known Issue: If your connection is unstable (high ping or packet loss), a connectivity server may appear as “available” even if it cannot actually be used.[/*]
You can now manually select which connectivity server to use.If you were unable to connect with your friends before, try using different connectivity servers. All players must have access to at least one shared server.This setting can also be adjusted for dedicated servers. Please allow some time for hosting providers to adapt to these changes, especially since it’s currently the weekend.

DIRECT IP CONNECTION

We also identified issues related to connections within the same network, as well as certain self-hosted dedicated server configurations. To address this, we’ve added the option to connect via Direct IP:
  • Direct IP Connection: A new option is now available when hosting a server (both in-game and dedicated). This works as an alternative to our connectivity services. When using Direct IP, players can only join via your IP address, and invite codes will not work. Dedicated server settings can be configured via ServerDescription.json.[/*]
  • Known Issue: When using Direct IP, if you enter an incorrect password or there is a version mismatch, the game will return you to the main menu without displaying an error message.[/*]
If you are unable to connect via connectivity services and none of them work for you (we’ve seen cases where ISPs block everything related to Windrose), you can try connecting via Direct IP as a workaround.Advanced feature: May require manual router configuration (port forwarding / NAT setup). This option is intended for advanced users.

SAVE BACKUPS

We discovered an issue where, in rare cases, player save files may become corrupted. This happens more frequently when playing across multiple machines while using Steam Cloud synchronization.We are still investigating the root cause. In the meantime, to mitigate the risk, we’ve added an automatic save backup system. Each time you launch the game, a backup of your save will be created. The system stores up to 30 backups, after which older ones are overwritten.Instructions on how to restore your save in case of corruption are provided below.We still recommend avoiding the use of cloud saves if possible while we continue investigating the issue.

HOW IT WORKS

  • An automatic save backup is created on game launch (both for client and dedicated server).[/*]
  • The maximum number of backup files is limited to 30.[/*]
  • Backups are stored in the folder:
    C:\\Users\\%username%\\AppData\\Local\\R5\\Saved\\SaveProfiles\\{steamid}_Backups[/*]
  • When the file limit is exceeded, older backups are deleted (the 31st backup replaces the oldest one).[/*]

HOW TO RESTORE BACKUP

  • Go to:
    C:\\Users\\%username%\\AppData\\Local\\R5\\Saved\\SaveProfiles\\%your_Steam_ID%_Backups[/*]
  • Select the latest backup (or any preferred one). Backups are named by date and time.[/*]
  • Copy all contents from this folder (it should contain one folder + AccountDescription.json).[/*]
  • Navigate to:
    C:\\Users\\%username%\\AppData\\Local\\R5\\Saved\\SaveProfiles\\{your_Steam_ID}\\RocksDB[/*]
  • Paste the copied files there (replace existing files if prompted).[/*]
For a dedicated server, the process is the same as for a local game. The difference is that save files are located inside the server’s installation folder.
  • Go to:
    \\R5\\Saved\\SaveProfiles\\Default_Backups\\[/*]
  • Find the relevant backup folder. Backups are named by date and time.[/*]
  • Copy the required files (folder + AccountDescription.json) from the chosen backup folder.[/*]
  • Paste them into the corresponding RocksDB folder of the active save, replacing files if needed.[/*]

OTHER FIXES

  • Fixed an issue that prevented loading into the main menu if your Windows username contained non-Unicode characters[/*]
  • When launching a server (either in-game or via a .bat file), its process priority is now automatically set to “Above Normal”[/*]
  • HDR can now be correctly activated[/*]
  • Increased grass render distance[/*]
  • Fixed a feather simulation bug for Plague Witch[/*]
  • Minor fixes to trader models, outfits, and poses[/*]
  • Fixed several rigging issues that caused armor clipping across various sets[/*]
  • Fixed a rare issue where the game could crash due to item-related bugs[/*]
